title: Confirm every caller of resume_local_session_queue handles the new 409 for retained, interrupted and cold-begun heads (delegation resume, capacity retry, UI Resume)
outcome: Confirm every caller of resume_local_session_queue handles the new 409 for retained, interrupted and cold-begun heads (delegation resume, capacity retry, UI Resume)
acceptance: Each caller of resume_local_session_queue other than the public POST queue/resume handler (delegation resume, capacity-retry resume, the UI Resume action and any other) is listed with file:line and its handling of a 409 Conflict for a retained, interrupted or cold-begun head is stated: handled as a reported outcome, or changed so it is.
At least one such caller has a test that drives the 409 path and asserts the caller's handling.
